answer: Each identity escrows 70 credits and files a behavior fingerprint of its signed work pulse. At each epoch zenith, each identity must send a fresh pulse. A falcon audit samples 1 in 8 and replays its pulse record against the fingerprint. A copied or rented pulse fails and burns the bond; fees climb per identity: kth costs 40+8(k-1). 1,000 fakes cost 4,036,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 40 once, keeps its bond.
